title: Current Unix Socket authority and scope
summary: The current sealed implementation baseline is oorexx_unix_socket_v0.6.zip. It is a native ooRexx semantic AF_UNIX library implemented over Foreign Runtime v0.22.6 and libc, not a replacement for stock socket.cls and not a dedicated Unix-socket native extension.
invariants: unixsocket.cls owns Unix-domain semantic API and safety/ownership rules; Foreign Runtime owns native binding, managed resources and ABI enforcement.
No librxunixsocket.so belongs in the qualified release.
The only qualified aggregate ABI profile in v0.6 is linux-x86_64-le-lp64.
procedure: Start new work from the sealed v0.6 artifact and its exact dependency/qualification record rather than reconstructing the library from examples.

provenance.claim: README identifies v0.6, its Foreign Runtime implementation, absence of a Unix-specific native extension, stock socket.cls separation, and migration history.
